review: The hymn is the herald's cry: 1:1–8 is Isa 52:7 (מְבַשֵּׂר שָׁלוֹם) with Mark 16:15 and Rom 10:18, 2:1–8 is 1 Cor 15:57 with Isa 61:1 and 1 Pet 2:24, and 3:1–8 is Acts 1:8 with Matt 10:27.

Every stanza repeats בְּיֵשׁוּעַ הַיְשׁוּעָה as its second and fourth lines and closes with it, exactly as the print repeats بِيَسُوعَ الْخَلَاص; the payload keeps the identical phrase in all twelve places, since the repetition is the hymn's refrain and its argument.
1:5 keeps אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ, the phrase of Isa 52:10 and Ps 98:3, rather than a general 'the whole world', because the stanza is quoting the servant-song's reach.
